component.name: Universal Git Infrastructure
component.description: Local-first Git workbench source release; Python local service and Persian RTL PWA.

properties.name: org.ugi.sbom.scope
properties.value: Source archive plus declared mandatory host prerequisites; incomplete for deployment.

properties.name: org.ugi.excluded-tooling
properties.value: Node.js is used for JavaScript syntax checks only; it is not a UGI product runtime requirement.

properties.name: org.ugi.inventory-limitations
properties.value: OS distribution packages, libc, TLS/OpenSSL provider, Git transitive packages, and distribution-specific Python notices are not expanded.

components.name: CPython
components.description: External host Python interpreter required by the UGI local service; not bundled.

properties.name: org.ugi.license-scope
properties.value: PSF-2.0 identifies the CPython core; distribution-specific bundled standard-library notices are not exhaustively inventoried.

components.name: Git CLI
components.description: External Git executable used by UGI subprocess operations; not bundled in the source archive.

properties.name: org.ugi.license-scope
properties.value: GPL-2.0-only is Git's main project license; some individual files may have compatible alternate licenses.
